author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/virtua-fighter-5-r-e-v-o-world-stage-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Bring the fight with you anytime, anywhere as Virtua Fighter makes its Nintendo debut on Nintendo Switch 2! Master every bone-shattering strike, throw, and combo across multiple modes, including the all new single-player journey, World Stage. Step into the arena against players worldwide with Cross Play and Rollback Netcode support, or sharpen your skills using newly enhanced Training and Replay tools designed for fighters of all levels. Plus, express your style with hundreds of character customization options! 

#NintendoSwitch2 #VirtuaFighter5

Light your way into the world of The Midnight Walk, handcrafted with real-life clay! Embark on a dark fantasy adventure in a world filled with wonder and terror. Use your companion Potboy to outsmart fire-eating monsters as you traverse twisted trails to survive The Dark Itself.
